# Explain a Quarkus Concept

Explain the requested concept using the smallest relevant example from this
repository. Do not edit files.

Cover:

- what the concept does and which runtime or build phase owns it;
- how it appears in the nearby project code;
- the smallest useful example or mental model;
- common mistakes and how to detect them with a test or Maven command;
- how this project might use the concept as it grows;
- one short exercise the learner can try next.

Distinguish Quarkus behavior from standard Java, Jakarta, JPA, REST Assured,
or Maven behavior. Say when an explanation is an informed inference rather
than something demonstrated by the current repository.
